details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. The summary maintains clear organization with related topics grouped together (revenue, profitability, investments, cash flow, financial position). There is no unnecessary repetition, and all numerical changes are presented without conflicting implications.
